entry.title: German exit polls suggest far-right party has big lead in regional election
entry.summary: The Alternative for Germany party has a strong lead in a regional election, but it is unclear if it will be able to form Germany's's first far-right state government since WWII, exit polls indicate.

entry.title: American Muslims are giving Texas barbecue a halal makeover
entry.summary: Even as anti-Muslim rhetoric rises in Texas, Muslim pitmasters are winning over diners and reshaping one of the state's most iconic culinary traditions.

entry.title: Witkoff and Kushner call Kyiv talks 'substantive' after Moscow Putin meeting
entry.summary: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held meetings in Kyiv with Ukraine's President Zelenskyy on Sunday, a day after lengthy conversations with Russian President Putin in Moscow.

entry.title: QUIZ: Ugh, I'll do it later. How much do you know about procrastination?
entry.summary: Learn a few surprising facts about procrastination — and helpful tools to overcome it — with this quiz. It's based on social scientist Itamar Shatz's new book, Solving Procrastination.

entry.title: Whatever happened to kindness? Spoiler alert: Our readers prove it's alive and well
entry.summary: We asked readers to share stories about a moment of kindness involving a stranger. Here are some of their heartwarming anecdotes.

entry.title: U.S. and Iran trade attacks on ships as fighting flares up again
Whatever happened to the floating schools of Bangladesh?
entry.summary: It was a light bulb moment: If monsoon rains keep kids from safely getting to school, let's create a floating school to pick them up! Bangladesh pioneered the idea. How's it doing?

entry.title: U.S. envoys in Moscow in new push for peace between Russia and Ukraine
entry.summary: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner have arrived in Moscow to revive efforts to end Russia's invasion of Ukraine. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has called for a halt to air attacks during their visit, but Moscow has not publicly responded.

entry.title: If you prefer puzzles to doomscrolling, here are 5 great games to check out
entry.summary: NPR's Linda Holmes is a daily puzzle devotee. She recommends games that will test your knowledge of geography, history, and even the most obscure corners of Wikipedia.

entry.title: 40 years later, 'The Baby-Sitters Club' is still helping readers see themselves
entry.summary: Ann M. Martin's beloved series has influenced generations of readers. We're still asking: Which babysitter are you?
